info.title: agentorg
info.summary: The record of agent sessions, tasks, asks, items and reports.

post.summary: Start a session, or resume it, and return the facts it acts on.
post.description: Call it first. It returns the session's id, its parent, its task, its own asks that are open or answered, and the reports to it not yet acknowledged. Starting again with the same client and client session id resumes the same session.

post.summary: Record the role the session declares: it manages or it executes.
Register something the session created, such as a worktree or a page, so that archiving the session lists it for cleanup.
Archive a session and return its cleanup list.
post.description: The list holds the items and evidence recorded against the session and the resources it registered. Its manager clears them.

post.summary: List sessions, oldest first.
Open a task. Asks and items belong to a task, and the page groups them by its project.
Close a task.
List tasks, oldest first.
Ask the user for a decision. It appears on the decisions page until answered.
post.description: Give the context a reader outside the session needs, two to six options, and the label of the option you recommend. Then wait for the answer with ask_wait, or keep working and read it later with ask_get.

post.summary: Read an ask, with its answer once it has one.
Wait until an ask is answered and return it.
post.description: With a timeout, return the ask after that long even if it is still open.

post.summary: Record an answer the user gave in the asking session's own conversation.
post.description: Quote the user's words exactly. Only the session that opened the ask may record its answer.

post.summary: Answer an ask as the user, with a choice, a note in the user's words, or both.
List asks, oldest first.
Create an open item, a workstream with its state, or replace one.
post.description: Keep the summary short; it is a status, not a log.

post.summary: Resolve an item, which removes it from the open workstreams.
List items, open ones only unless asked otherwise, oldest first.
Send a report to the session's parent. It stays in the parent's inbox until the parent acknowledges it.
Read the reports to the session that it has not acknowledged.
Acknowledge a report, after reviewing it. Only its recipient may.
List audit entries, newest first.
Mint a one-time link that signs the browser in to the decisions page.
